svg.title: FootyLevels system context
svg.desc: Players use the iOS app. The app signs in with Firebase, talks to the FootyLevels API through ngrok for records and jobs, and moves video bytes directly to and from Supabase. The DGX runs the API, workers and the 3D model runtime; Gemini writes lessons.
